48.original: That tome...that wouldn't happen to be a sightseeing log, would it?

49.original: Millith! Now that's a name I haven't heard in a good long time. And dearest Elsebee...

50.original: She's my twin sister, you see, and I haven't seen her for thirty long years. Not since I was trapped during my exploration of Yyasulani.

51.original: It brings me great joy to know she is well. Pardon me for asking, but...might I see the notes she added to your log?

52.original: She always did make such bold strokes of her lettering... Here.

53.original: I've added my own notes. Some of the information may seem improbable at best, but I believe there is truth in every entry.

54.original: Were I younger, I would set out in search of these fantastic sights myself, but alas, my body can no longer endure such travels.

55.original: Though thanks to you, I feel lighter than I have in an age. If there is one thing I should wish, it is to see my sister again before I die. There is so much I would share with her...

56.original: But you have better things to attend to than an old woman's musings. Take care, kind adventurer. And may your journey lead you to vistas both bright and unforgettable.

57.original: New Dawntrail entries have been added to your sightseeing log!

58.original: You wouldn't happen to know any experienced explorers, would you? I'm looking for someone to seek what vistas I cannot...

59.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must be level 90 or above.
